    {"slide": 1, "does": "Recall equal sharing", "look_at": {"kind": "picture", "shows": "Twelve apples ready to share between three baskets"}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 2, "does": "Introduce the approved objectives", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 3, "does": "Model finding a unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Twenty-four counters shared into six equal groups"}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 4, "does": "Check a matching unit-fraction calculation", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Thirty counters shared into six equal groups"}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 5, "does": "Model finding a non-unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Three of five equal parts of twenty selected"}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 6, "does": "Check a matching non-unit-fraction calculation", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 7, "does": "Correct dividing by the numerator", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Four equal parts of twenty, with three selected"}, "teaches": [1, 2]},
    {"slide": 8, "does": "Check the method before word problems", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 9, "does": "Model a fraction-of-money word problem", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Forty pounds split into five parts, with three selected"}, "teaches": [2, 3]},
    {"slide": 10, "does": "Check a matching money problem", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [3]},
    {"slide": 11, "does": "Apply the method to quantities and measures", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1, 2, 3]},
    {"slide": 12, "does": "Apply the method to a new practical decision", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2, 3]}
  ],
  "title": {
    "template": "title",
    "heading": "Fractions of amounts",
    "lead": "Share 12 apples equally between 3 baskets. How many in each?",
    "picture": {
      "shows": "twelve separate apples beside three empty baskets",
      "must_see": ["twelve separate apples", "three empty baskets"],
      "subject": "generic"
    }
  },
  "slides": [
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Find one sixth of 24",
      "lead": "One sixth means one of six equal parts.",
      "points": [
        "Share 24 into 6 equal groups.",
        "24 ÷ 6 = 4",
        "One sixth of 24 is 4."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "equal-groups",
        "shows": "Twenty-four counters divided into six equal groups of four.",
        "alt": "Six rings each contain four counters, making twenty-four altogether.",
        "title": null,
        "total": 24,
        "groups": 6,
        "layout": "rings",
        "show_count": "each",
        "unknown": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "big-visual",
      "heading": "Find one sixth of 30",
      "lead": "Write a division calculation and your answer.",
      "figure": {
        "kind": "equal-groups",
        "shows": "Thirty counters divided into six equal groups for pupils to count.",
        "alt": "Thirty counters are shared equally between six rings; each group's count is unknown.",
        "title": null,
        "total": 30,
        "groups": 6,
        "layout": "rings",
        "show_count": "each",
        "unknown": true
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "equation-hero",
      "heading": "Find three fifths of 20",
      "lead": null,
      "formula": "20 ÷ 5 × 3 = 12",
      "points": [
        "Find one fifth: 20 ÷ 5 = 4.",
        "Take three fifths: 4 × 3 = 12.",
        "Three fifths of 20 is 12."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "Twenty split into five equal parts of four, with three parts shaded.",
        "alt": "A bar of twenty has five equal parts of four; three parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": "20",
            "whole": 20,
            "parts": 5,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 3,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": null
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Find three fifths of 30",
      "questions": [
        "What is one fifth of 30?",
        "What is three fifths of 30?",
        "Write one calculation showing both steps."
      ],
      "instruction": "Work on your own. Show your working.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Which number tells us to divide?",
      "lead": "For three quarters of 20, divide by 4, not 3.",
      "points": [
        {"label": "Denominator", "text": "The bottom number gives the number of equal parts."},
        {"label": "Numerator", "text": "The top number gives the number of parts to take."}
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "Twenty split into four equal parts, with three parts selected.",
        "alt": "A bar of twenty is split into four parts of five, with three parts shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": "20",
            "whole": 20,
            "parts": 4,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 3,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": null
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "hinge",
      "heading": "Choose the calculation",
      "stem": "Which calculation finds two thirds of 18?",
      "options": [
        "18 ÷ 2 × 3",
        "18 ÷ 3 × 2",
        "18 ÷ 3",
        "18 × 2"
      ],
      "correct": 2
    },
    {
      "template": "equation-hero",
      "heading": "How much does Aisha spend?",
      "lead": "Aisha has £40. She spends three fifths of it.",
      "formula": "40 ÷ 5 × 3 = 24",
      "points": [
        "One fifth: £40 ÷ 5 = £8.",
        "Three fifths: £8 × 3 = £24.",
        "Aisha spends £24."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "Forty pounds divided into five equal shares, with three shares shaded.",
        "alt": "A forty-pound bar has five equal parts of eight pounds; three parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [
          {
            "label": "Money",
            "whole": 40,
            "parts": 5,
            "values": null,
            "shaded": 3,
            "unknown": "none",
            "unit": "£"
          }
        ],
        "combined": false
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "How much does Ben spend?",
      "questions": [
        "Ben has £50. He spends three fifths of it. How much does he spend?"
      ],
      "instruction": "Write your calculation and answer in pounds.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Use fractions to solve problems",
      "questions": [
        "A box holds 36 pencils. One quarter are red. How many pencils are red?",
        "A ribbon is 35 cm long. Mia cuts off three fifths. How many centimetres does she cut off?",
        "Stretch: Sam uses two thirds of a 24 m rope. Jo uses three quarters of a 20 m rope. Who uses more metres? Explain."
      ],
      "instruction": "Show your working. Include the unit.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Will the juice be enough?",
      "questions": [
        "A jug holds 900 ml of juice. Four fifths of the juice is poured into a bottle. How much goes into the bottle?",
        "The bottle must hold at least 700 ml for a picnic. Is there enough juice in it? Explain."
      ],
      "instruction": "Calculate, then justify your decision.",
      "picture": null
    }
  ]
}
